input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) contains no exit-assistance or data-return obligation. Section 10.1 merely presupposes "any agreed transition period" without obliging Vendor to provide one, and 10.2 covers only Deliverables and refunds. Searches for transition, export, return and deletion language return nothing else: Section 15 (Customer Data and Privacy) addresses processing limits only, and Section 16.5 excludes Customer Data from the return-or-destroy duty by referring it to "Sections 11 and 15" — but no Section 11 exists in the document. As a hosted-services agreement with no data return or export right, this fails the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days), so we insert a new Section 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (with a carve-out for routine backups and legal retention, consistent with Section 16.5).

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter, as the Agreement currently gives us no exit or data-return rights (Section 16.5 even cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). We can accept ninety days of transition assistance if six months is problematic.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.
